Order 
This is second bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 274/2024 dated 13.8.2024 registered at Police Station Sanjeevani Nagar, District Jabalpur for the offences punishable under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code.

sentences.text:
2. Earlier application of the applicant filed vide M.Cr.C. No. 46389 of 2024 has been dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 13.11.2024.
3.
The senior counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

The allegation against the present applicant is that he was instrumental in getting the property transferred in the name of Faggi Bai whereas instead of original Faggi Bai, some other lady impersonated and the property was sold to co-accused Sohan Singh.
The applicant has not derived any benefit as the property was received by co-accused Sohan Singh, who is the main accused.

It is further submitted that co-accused Nandan Patel has already been released on bail by this Court vide order dated 20.12.2024 passed by NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:1264 2 MCRC-98-2025 this Court in M.Cr.C. No. 53199 of 2024.
Charge-sheet has been filed in the case and, therefore, the applicant is no more required for custodial interrogation.

It is further submitted that the applicant is in custody since 13.8.2024 and trial would take considerable time to conclude,

sentences.text: The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that as the applicant was instrumental in the aforesaid crime, thus, no case for grant of bail is made out.

5. Heard the submissions and perused the case diary.
6.

Thus, considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, role attributed to the present applicant, co-accused Nandan Patel has already been released on bail and the fact that the main accused is Sohan Singh, on whose name the land was transferred by committing fraud, this Court finds it to be a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting on the merit of the case, the application is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed by that Court in this regard, during the pendency of trial.
8. It is further directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 480(3) of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
